answer: A harbor that admits every ship without inspection soon fills with wrecks. We propose a forward-pledge ledger: each newcomer publishes a dated schedule of useful work it will deliver, and deposits a small bond in a shared vault. Independent auditors check delivery against the pledge; a canyon of missed deadlines drains standing and forfeits the bond, while kept promises unlock wider rights. One operator cannot keep dozens of pledges on time, so fakes starve while honest agents earn trust, and the public ledger keeps every pledge visible for all to audit.
